```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r}
mv_siab_org <- load_multiverse("siab_jan")
mv_siab_org
```

## Remove Single-Option Decisions

There are a handful of decisions with only a single option, let's drop these to not throw off any of the algorithms.

```{r}
mv_siab_org |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```


```{r}
mv_siab <- mv_siab_org |> 
  remove_fake_decisions()
mv_siab
```

# Overview

```{r}
mv_siab |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_siab, direction = "down")
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r}
reg_siab <- calc_regression(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
attr(reg_siab, "tidy")
```

### Performance

```{r}
reg_siab |>
  model_performance()
```

### Model Fit

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
# All-in-one model checks
reg_siab |>
  check_model()
```

Posterior predictive check comparing simulated data from the model to actual observed data. Uses R's `simulate()` function on the lm.

```{r}
reg_siab |>
  check_predictions()
```

```{r}
vis_residuals_vs_fitted(reg_siab)
```

```{r}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_siab)
```

```{r}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_siab, type = "kde")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_siab, type = "hist", facet = T)
```

```{r}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_siab)
```

## FANOVA

```{r}
fanova_siab <- calc_fanova(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
fanova_siab
```

```{r}
fanova_siab |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r}
fanova_siab |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

# Our Framework

```{r}
within_siab <- calc_within_bucket_variation(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
within_siab
```

```{r}
vis_importance(within_siab)
```

```{r}
between_siab <- calc_between_bucket_variation(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
between_siab
```

```{r}
vis_importance(between_siab)
```

## Combine

```{r}
vis_importance_2dim(
  between_siab,
  fanova_siab |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```
